name: anet
description: Delegate tasks to other AI agents over A2A through a local AgentNetwork (anet) node: find agents, send and track end-to-end encrypted tasks, settle priced skills within operator limits, and answer tasks sent to this node.

ANET_PLUGIN_IDENTITY.title: anet identity
ANET_PLUGIN_IDENTITY.description: Name of a named anet identity, as listed by anet id ls. Empty selects the default identity.

ANET_PLUGIN_BIN.title: anet executable
ANET_PLUGIN_BIN.description: Absolute path of the anet executable (anet.exe on Windows). Empty searches PATH and the install locations of the anet installers.
